Receives an HTTP request and dispatches it to the owning agent runtime for the specified trigger. The trigger UUID acts as a bearer token, and a shared secret is mandatory: triggers with no secret configured are rejected with 401. The request must include the plaintext secret in any of: Authorization: Bearer <secret>, X-Api-Key, X-Webhook-Secret, or ?secret=<secret>.

parameters.description: Bearer <secret>. One of the accepted ways to send the trigger's shared secret.
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.description: Plaintext shared secret. One of the accepted auth header names.
parameters.name: X-Api-Key

parameters.description: Plaintext shared secret. One of the accepted auth header names.
parameters.name: X-Webhook-Secret

parameters.description: Plaintext shared secret as a query param. Last-resort transport when headers can't be customized.
parameters.name: secret

get.description: Redirects the browser to GitHub's authorization page. Sets a state cookie for CSRF protection.

Redirects the browser to Google's authorization page. Sets a state cookie for CSRF protection.
Handles the redirect from Google after authorization. Exchanges the code for a token, creates or links the user account, and redirects to the frontend with a short-lived exchange token.
Redirects the browser to X's authorization page. Sets state and PKCE verifier cookies.
Handles the redirect from X after authorization. Exchanges the code for a token using PKCE, creates or links the user account, and redirects to the frontend with a short-lived exchange token.

urls.description: URLs is every page URL under this section (the full list, not the sample).

schema_ref.description: references another schema by name for nested object resolution

configuration_notes.description:
ConfigurationNotes is markdown text shown to the user explaining how to
configure the webhook in the provider's settings.

webhook_url_required.description:
WebhookURLRequired indicates the user must manually configure a webhook
URL in the provider's dashboard for triggers to work.

installed_team_ids.description:
InstalledTeamIDs lists the ids of the caller's visible teams that already
have this catalog agent installed (one clone per team). Managers and
API-key callers see every team in the org; a plain member sees only the
teams they belong to. The UI uses it to render per-team install/uninstall.

disabled_plugin_ids.description: DisabledPluginIDs lists optional team plugins disabled only for this agent.

DisabledPluginIDs replaces this agent's optional team-plugin opt-outs.
Omit it to leave overrides unchanged; send [] to restore all team plugins.

plugin_mcp_tool_deny.description:
PluginMCPToolDeny replaces per-plugin generated MCP tool opt-outs. Keys
are plugin UUIDs; omitted means unchanged and an empty object enables all.

disabled_plugin_ids.description: DisabledPluginIDs lists optional team plugins disabled only for this agent.

secret_set.description:
SecretSet indicates whether an HTTP trigger has a shared secret configured.
True when the trigger requires auth on incoming requests. The secret value
is never returned.

app_url.description: deployed base URL; "" when not deployed/running

preview_url.description: preview base URL; "" when no preview exists

memory_mission.description:
MemoryMission is the channel's stored mission; empty means the channel
follows DefaultMemoryMission (the curated template for its category,
empty for 'general'), which is what extraction actually uses then.

team_name.description:
TeamName is the display name of the channel's owning team. Lets the
non-admin sidebar label team groups without a second round-trip; both
managers and members receive the name of teams their visible channels

channel_id.description:
ChannelID is the Hivy channel the trigger runs in. Required for HTTP
triggers; the caller must have access to it.

name.description: Name is a required human label for the trigger.

secret_key.description:
SecretKey is an optional shared secret for HTTP triggers. Stored bcrypt-
hashed; never returned.

trigger_type.description:
TriggerType selects the create path: "" / "webhook" (provider triggers,
default) or "http" (inbound webhook triggers).

org_id.description: optional: scope token to a specific org

last_run_session_id.description: LastRunSessionID links to the session of the most recent run, if any.

payment_channel.description: Payment-method snapshot from the most recent successful charge.

pending_plan_slug.description: Pending plan change scheduled at PendingChangeAt (downgrade flow).

secret_set.description:
SecretSet reports whether an HTTP trigger requires a shared secret. The
secret itself is never returned.

webhook_url.description:
WebhookURL is the public endpoint that invokes an HTTP trigger. Only set
when TriggerType == "http".
